toolchain.note: make dist-linux-amd64 builds inside the pinned image

notes: Same result as nimbus-eth2: the .text section is bit-identical to the published v0.4.4 nimbus binary, but the full binary does not converge, because of (1) a Nim 'Compiled at <date>' banner in .rodata and (2) environment-dependent .symtab/.strtab symbol ordering (the bulk of the diff; no code change). Deterministic on a fixed machine+date, divergent across machines/days. Note: the GitHub release tarball (nimbus-linux-amd64-<v>-<commit>.tar.gz) is a REPACKAGE of the dist output (just build/nimbus), so only the binary is verifiable, not the tarball. Status fixes: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for the banner + deterministic symbol order -> full.
